source: Final shared working tree after local native deployment and auth/web restart; uncommitted source changes are reviewed by root.

paperlessInternalVisibility.qualification: Actual public /api/mutation endpoint with real authenticated Better Auth Owner and anonymous caller; server rejects internal visibility before validation/handler execution; complete visible sync and connection snapshots unchanged.
limitations: No existing Paperless sync fixture; refresh visibility is rejected before validating supplied ID. This does not qualify internal handler network integration.

oracle: Actual isolated local Convex public HTTP API, actual Better Auth email session and broker JWT verification; no mocked database, principal, or transport. Operator-only local fixture wrappers supply synthetic records and perform cleanup.
boundaries: Scenario groups contain multiple role, hostile-principal, and mutation assertions; group counts are not individual assertion counts.
Local configured Better Auth exercised on network; Clerk identity parity and tenant-restricted Microsoft SSO are qualified by separate native identity oracles, not a real remote sign-in here.
Storage tests upload/download synthetic native bytes; deterministic external-provider adapters, browser views, PowerSync replication, and external production credentials are separate qualifications.
Projection batch-finance and scoped-service details are native-oracle-only; these live projections use real broker user principals.
Paperless visibility tests prove internal endpoints cannot be called publicly; they do not invoke a production Paperless server.
Browser viewport and Electron runtime/package qualification are reported separately.
